provider: Azure DevOps Repos (Git as bulk blob store)

free_tier.stated: Unlimited private Git repositories free per organization; each repository may be up to 250 GB; storage is NOT a billed meter - the Azure DevOps free tier bills only users, parallel jobs and Artifacts storage. Git LFS is free and does not count toward the 5 GB push limit.
free_tier.notes: Headline offer; binding constraint specified in limits.

per_object_cap.stated: No per-object cap documented in published terms; absence is not an unlimited claim.
per_object_cap.notes: extraction found no per-object clause; some of these providers meter on object count rather than bytes, and some state no cap

retention.stated: No retention statement documented in published terms; absence is not an unlimited claim.
retention.notes: No retention clause documented in available terms.

egress.terms: Unmetered. Clone/fetch over HTTPS from dev.azure.com has no egress meter - the billing FAQ enumerates every chargeable meter (extra Basic users, Basic+Test Plans, parallel jobs, Artifacts >2 GB, GHAS) and data transfer is not among them.

tooling: Plain git / git-lfs; Azure DevOps REST API for repository + item download (GET /_apis/git/repositories/{repo}/items?path=); rclone has no ADO Repos backend, so use git or the REST item API
chaining: Unlimited repos x 250 GB each within one org; each org holds up to 1,000 projects; orgs are free and you may hold many. 250 GB x N repos x M orgs. The 2026 sprint-273 change removed the Git object-count limit, which was the per-repo ceiling that used to bite before 250 GB. Files are content-addressed and deduplicated across history, so a repo of distinct chunks stores each chunk once.
limits_note: 250 GB per repository (soft - pack-file limit errors before it); 5 GB per push (LFS pushes exempt); individual files ~100 MB without LFS; path length 32,766 chars; rate limits 200 TSTU per 5-min window; anonymous access to public projects is being removed (new public projects blocked April 2026, all converted to private and anonymous disabled in 2027) - authenticate with a PAT.

reliability_note: Reliable but slow as bulk storage: no random-access read, no partial download, whole-repo clone semantics; the 'temporarily unavailable while repository is updated' pack-optimization window can block writes for large repos.
